title: OP_ENTER moves post arguments over the block's register, then allocates: the Proc is collected and the method reads the slot's next occupant
live_proof: upstream fixed it in 39aecc143 (39aecc143f92ec365bf04c88abc62ffe09b6c74c) (2026-09-08), which is in master and postdates the 4.0.0-rc2 pin (2026-03-12); the pin's tree has no such fix. Host ASan at the pin: a report my first pattern missed (with MRB_HEAP_PAGE_SIZE=1: heap-use-after-free); the same case on master: no report
fidelity: the trigger is the Ruby test upstream added with its fix, extracted onto a self-contained harness that collects failures instead of aborting, so one script yields one verdict. It is upstream's own reproduction, not a reduction of ours; what it does NOT establish is which arm ought to catch it
